(* 2.1 Radar Altimeter 2oo3 Validation & Median Voting Logic                                     *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Range sanity check: Radar Altimeter valid envelope [0.0 m to 8000.0 m] *)
bHealth_Alt_ChA := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= 8000.0);
bHealth_Alt_ChB := (rRadarAlt_ChB_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= 8000.0);
bHealth_Alt_ChC := (rRadarAlt_ChC_m >= 0.0) AND (rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= 8000.0);

IF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChB AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    (* All 3 channels online: check cross-channel discrepancies *)
    IF (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChA_m - rRadarAlt_ChB_m) > c_rAltTol_m) OR
       (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChB_m - rRadarAlt_ChC_m) > c_rAltTol_m) OR
       (ABS(rRadarAlt_ChA_m - rRadarAlt_ChC_m) > c_rAltTol_m) THEN
        rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy := rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
        IF rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy >= 0.150 THEN
            wFaultWord_Degraded.0 := TRUE; (* Altimeter discrepancy latch *)
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rTimer_Alt_Discrepancy := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    (* True Median Voting 3oo3 Algorithm *)
    IF ((rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChC_m)) OR
       ((rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m)) THEN
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChB_m;
    ELSIF ((rRadarAlt_ChB_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChC_m)) OR
          ((rRadarAlt_ChC_m <= rRadarAlt_ChA_m) AND (rRadarAlt_ChA_m <= rRadarAlt_ChB_m)) THEN
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChA_m;
    ELSE
        rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChC_m;
    END_IF;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 0; (* Nominal 3oo3 *)
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChB THEN
    (* Channel C failed: Degrade to 1oo2 averaging between A and B *)
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m + rRadarAlt_ChB_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1; (* Degraded 1oo2 *)
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChB AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChB_m + rRadarAlt_ChC_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA AND bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := (rRadarAlt_ChA_m + rRadarAlt_ChC_m) * 0.50;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 1;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.1 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChA THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChA_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2; (* Degraded 1oo1 single string *)
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChB THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChB_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bHealth_Alt_ChC THEN
    rVoted_Alt_m := rRadarAlt_ChC_m;
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 2;
    wFaultWord_Degraded.2 := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* All 3 Radar Altimeters Failed: Critical Bus Fault *)
    iDegradeMode_Alt := 3;
    wFaultWord_Critical.0 := TRUE; (* Altimeter loss triggers abort *)
END_IF;

ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChA AND bHealth_VelZ_ChB THEN
    rVoted_VelZ_mps := (rDopplerVel_Z_ChA_mps + rDopplerVel_Z_ChB_mps) * 0.50;

ELSIF bHealth_VelZ_ChB AND bHealth_VelZ_ChC THEN

wDiagnosticSubKelvin_LCH4.1 := (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar > 2.80);

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.2 LOX TVS Joule-Thomson Vent Valve Modulating Closed-Loop Controller                       *)
(* Target Ullage Pressure: 2.15 bar. If subcooling margin drops < 0.85 K, JT valve cracks open  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar > 2.15) OR (rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85) THEN
    (* Closed-loop proportional-integral expansion throttling *)
    rTempSum := (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar - 2.15) * 45.0 + (0.85 - rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K) * 20.0;
    rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral + (rTempSum * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.10);
    IF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN
        rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 40.0;
    ELSIF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN
        rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := rTempSum + rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral;
    (* Activate submerged destratification mixer pump *)
    bTVS_MixerPump_LOX_Cmd := TRUE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec := rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
ELSE
    rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral - (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 2.0);
    IF rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rLOX_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
    bTVS_MixerPump_LOX_Cmd := FALSE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LOX_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp LOX JT Valve [0.0% to 100.0%] *)
IF rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct < 0.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.3 LCH4 TVS Joule-Thomson Vent Valve Modulating Closed-Loop Controller                      *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar > 2.15) OR (rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K < 0.85) THEN
    rTempSum := (rVoted_TankPress_LCH4_bar - 2.15) * 45.0 + (0.85 - rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K) * 20.0;
    rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral + (rTempSum * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.10);
    IF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral > 40.0 THEN
        rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 40.0;
    ELSIF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN
        rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := rTempSum + rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral;
    bTVS_MixERPump_LCH4_Cmd := TRUE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec := rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
ELSE
    rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral - (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 2.0);
    IF rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral < 0.0 THEN rLCH4_TVS_PID_Integral := 0.0; END_IF;
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
    bTVS_MixerPump_LCH4_Cmd := FALSE;
    rMixerPumpRunTimer_LCH4_Sec := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct > 100.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
ELSIF rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct < 0.0 THEN
    rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 4: FLASH LIDAR TERRAIN HAZARD EVALUATION & RETARGETING DIVERT PLANNER                *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Trigger Criteria: Active between 250 m and 30 m altitude, hazard score > 0.45 or slope > 7.0 deg *)
IF (rVoted_Alt_m <= 250.0) AND (rVoted_Alt_m >= 30.0) AND (NOT bDivertInitiated) THEN
    IF (rLidarHazardScore_Norm >= 0.45) OR (rLidarSlope_deg >= 7.0) THEN
        (* Initialize Autonomous Hazard Divert Maneuver *)
        bDivertInitiated := TRUE;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive := TRUE;
        rDivertTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        rDivertOrigin_X_m := rNavPosition_X_m;
        rDivertOrigin_Y_m := rNavPosition_Y_m;
        (* Clamp maximum autonomous lateral translation to 65.0 meters *)
        rDivertTarget_X_m := rNavPosition_X_m + rLidarTargetOffset_X_m;
        rDivertTarget_Y_m := rNavPosition_Y_m + rLidarTargetOffset_Y_m;
        IF (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) > 65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_X_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m + 65.0;
        ELSIF (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) < -65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_X_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m - 65.0;
        END_IF;
        IF (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) > 65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_Y_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m + 65.0;
        ELSIF (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) < -65.0 THEN
            rDivertTarget_Y_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m - 65.0;
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Quintic Minimum-Jerk Polynomial Divert Trajectory Profile Generation *)
IF bDivertInitiated THEN
    rDivertTimer_Sec := rDivertTimer_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
    IF rDivertTimer_Sec < rDivertDuration_Sec THEN
        (* Normalized tau in [0.0, 1.0] *)
        rTauDivert := rDivertTimer_Sec / rDivertDuration_Sec;
        rTauSquared := rTauDivert * rTauDivert;
        rTauCubed   := rTauSquared * rTauDivert;
        (* Quintic smooth step: s(tau) = 10*tau^3 - 15*tau^4 + 6*tau^5 *)
        rPolyScale := (10.0 * rTauCubed) - (15.0 * rTauSquared * rTauDivert) + (6.0 * rTauCubed * rTauSquared);
        rDivertCmd_PosX_m := rDivertOrigin_X_m + ((rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) * rPolyScale);
        rDivertCmd_PosY_m := rDivertOrigin_Y_m + ((rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) * rPolyScale);
        (* Velocity derivative: ds/dtau = 30*tau^2 - 60*tau^3 + 30*tau^4 *)
        rPolyScale := ((30.0 * rTauSquared) - (60.0 * rTauCubed) + (30.0 * rTauCubed * rTauDivert)) / rDivertDuration_Sec;
        rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := (rDivertTarget_X_m - rDivertOrigin_X_m) * rPolyScale;
        rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := (rDivertTarget_Y_m - rDivertOrigin_Y_m) * rPolyScale;
    ELSE
        rDivertCmd_PosX_m := rDivertTarget_X_m;
        rDivertCmd_PosY_m := rDivertTarget_Y_m;
        rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := 0.0;
        rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := 0.0;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive := FALSE; (* Divert complete *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rDivertCmd_PosX_m := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_PosY_m := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_VelX_mps := 0.0;
    rDivertCmd_VelY_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) 6-DOF DESCENT TRAJECTORY OPTIMIZER                 *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.1 Assemble State Vector x = [pz, vz, px, vx, py, vy]^T and Target Vector                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
aX_Current[1] := rVoted_Alt_m;
aX_Current[2] := rVoted_VelZ_mps;
aX_Current[3] := rNavPosition_X_m;
aX_Current[4] := rNavVelocity_X_mps;
aX_Current[5] := rNavPosition_Y_m;
aX_Current[6] := rNavVelocity_Y_mps;

(* Set dynamic tracking targets depending on mission phase *)
IF bDivertInitiated THEN
    aX_Target[3] := rDivertCmd_PosX_m;
    aX_Target[4] := rDivertCmd_VelX_mps;
    aX_Target[5] := rDivertCmd_PosY_m;
    aX_Target[6] := rDivertCmd_VelY_mps;
ELSE
    aX_Target[3] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[4] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[5] := 0.0;
    aX_Target[6] := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.2 Discrete Horizon Forward Rollout Prediction (Np = 5 steps)                                *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
    aX_Pred[1, iLoopI] := aX_Current[iLoopI];
END_FOR;

FOR iLoopK := 1 TO 4 DO
    FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := 0.0;
        FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 6 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aA_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aX_Pred[iLoopK, iLoopJ]);
        END_FOR;
        FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
            rTempSum := rTempSum + (aB_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aU_Current[iLoopJ]);
        END_FOR;
        (* Compensate for lunar gravity in vertical velocity channel *)
        IF iLoopI = 2 THEN
            rTempSum := rTempSum - (c_rMoonGravity_mps2 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
        END_IF;
        aX_Pred[iLoopK + 1, iLoopI] := rTempSum;
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.3 Quadratic Cost Function Gradient Evaluation: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_pred - x_target) + R*u *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopI := 1 TO 6 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + aB_Matrix[iLoopI, iLoopJ] * aQ_Weight[iLoopI] * (aX_Pred[5, iLoopI] - aX_Target[iLoopI]);
    END_FOR;
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (aR_Weight[iLoopJ] * aU_Current[iLoopJ]);
    rTempSum := rTempSum + (aS_Weight[iLoopJ] * (aU_Current[iLoopJ] - aU_Prev[iLoopJ]));
    aGrad_J[iLoopJ] := rTempSum;
END_FOR;

(* Projected Gradient Descent Update Step *)
FOR iLoopJ := 1 TO 3 DO
    aU_Prev[iLoopJ] := aU_Current[iLoopJ];
    aU_Current[iLoopJ] := aU_Current[iLoopJ] - (rStepAlpha * aGrad_J[iLoopJ]);
END_FOR;

(* Box Constraints on Commanded Accelerations [m/s^2] *)
IF aU_Current[1] < 0.20 THEN
    aU_Current[1] := 0.20; (* Lower vertical accel limit to avoid free-fall *)
ELSIF aU_Current[1] > 6.20 THEN
    aU_Current[1] := 6.20; (* Upper vertical accel clamp *)
END_IF;

IF aU_Current[2] < -1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[2] := -1.80;
ELSIF aU_Current[2] > 1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[2] := 1.80;
END_IF;

IF aU_Current[3] < -1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[3] := -1.80;
ELSIF aU_Current[3] > 1.80 THEN
    aU_Current[3] := 1.80;
END_IF;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.4 Transform Commanded Accelerations to Total Thrust Vector & Gimbal Attitude Angles        *)
(* Total Net Acceleration: a_total = sqrt((a_z + g_Moon)^2 + a_x^2 + a_y^2)                    *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rNormAccel := SQRT(((aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2) * (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2)) +
                   (aU_Current[2] * aU_Current[2]) + (aU_Current[3] * aU_Current[3]));

(* Convert to commanded Newtons and kilonewtons *)
rTotalThrustForce_N := rEstimatedMass_kg * rNormAccel;
rDesiredThrust_kN := rTotalThrustForce_N * 0.0010;

(* Gimbal Angle Spherical Projections [rad to deg] *)
IF (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2) > 0.05 THEN
    rPitchAngleRad := aU_Current[2] / (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2);
    rYawAngleRad   := aU_Current[3] / (aU_Current[1] + c_rMoonGravity_mps2);
    rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg := rPitchAngleRad * 57.29578;
    rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg   := rYawAngleRad   * 57.29578;
ELSE
    rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg := 0.0;
    rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg   := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 6: VARIABLE-AREA PINTLE INJECTOR 10:1 DEEP THROTTLING & MIXTURE CONTROL              *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* First-order lag thrust demand filtering to prevent acoustic shockwave *)
rFilteredThrust_kN := rFilteredThrust_kN + (c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 15.0 * (rDesiredThrust_kN - rFilteredThrust_kN));

(* Deep Throttling Dynamic Saturation: Strict 10:1 envelope [6.50 kN to 65.00 kN] *)
IF rFilteredThrust_kN > c_rMaxThrust_kN THEN
    rFilteredThrust_kN := c_rMaxThrust_kN;
ELSIF rFilteredThrust_kN < c_rMinThrust_kN THEN
    rFilteredThrust_kN := c_rMinThrust_kN;
END_IF;
rThrustCmd_kN := rFilteredThrust_kN;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 Non-Linear Pintle Sleeve Stroke Characteristic Mapping                                   *)
(* Cubic Spline Interpolation: x_p = 0.285*F - 0.0014*F^2 + 0.000008*F^3                        *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rPintleFeedforward_mm := (0.2850 * rThrustCmd_kN) -
                        (0.00140 * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN) +
                        (0.0000080 * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN * rThrustCmd_kN);

(* Closed-Loop Chamber Pressure Feedback Trim *)
rChamberPress_Target_bar := (rThrustCmd_kN / c_rMaxThrust_kN) * 70.0; (* 7.0 bar to 70.0 bar *)
rChamberPress_Error_bar  := rChamberPress_Target_bar - rChamberPress_Pc_bar;
rChamberPress_Integrator := rChamberPress_Integrator + (rChamberPress_Error_bar * c_rCycleDeltaT_s * 0.45);
IF rChamberPress_Integrator > 1.25 THEN
    rChamberPress_Integrator := 1.25;
ELSIF rChamberPress_Integrator < -1.25 THEN
    rChamberPress_Integrator := -1.25;
END_IF;

rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm := rPintleFeedforward_mm + (rChamberPress_Error_bar * 0.085) + rChamberPress_Integrator;

(* Pintle Sleeve Stroke Mechanical Clamping [1.85 mm to 18.50 mm] *)
IF rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm > c_rMaxPintleStroke_mm THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := c_rMaxPintleStroke_mm;
ELSIF rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm < c_rMinPintleStroke_mm THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
ELSE
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPintleSleeveCmd_Unclamped_mm;
END_IF;

(* Pintle Actuator Dynamic Slew Rate Limiter (max 50.0 mm/s) *)
rPintleSlewRate_mmps := (rPintleStrokeCmd_mm - rPrevPintleCmd_mm) / c_rCycleDeltaT_s;
IF rPintleSlewRate_mmps > 50.0 THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPrevPintleCmd_mm + (50.0 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF rPintleSlewRate_mmps < -50.0 THEN
    rPintleStrokeCmd_mm := rPrevPintleCmd_mm - (50.0 * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevPintleCmd_mm := rPintleStrokeCmd_mm;

(* Pintle Acoustic Stability Check: Injection Differential Ratio *)
IF rChamberPress_Pc_bar > 2.0 THEN
    rCavitationAcousticMargin := (rVoted_TankPress_LOX_bar - rChamberPress_Pc_bar) / rChamberPress_Pc_bar;
    IF rCavitationAcousticMargin < 0.18 THEN
        wFaultWord_Degraded.6 := TRUE; (* Impending acoustic chugging detected *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Mixture Ratio Monitoring *)
IF rMassFlow_LCH4_kgps > 0.05 THEN
    rActiveMixtureRatio := rMassFlow_LOX_kgps / rMassFlow_LCH4_kgps;
ELSE
    rActiveMixtureRatio := c_rNominalMixtureRatio;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 7: DUAL-AXIS ELECTROMECHANICAL GIMBAL & ANTI-SLOSH NOTCH FILTERING                   *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.1 Pitch Gimbal Discrete Biquad Notch Filter (Removes Propellant Slosh Mode at 1.45 Hz)     *)
(* Difference equation: y[k] = b0*x[k] + b1*x[k-1] + b2*x[k-2] - a1*y[k-1] - a2*y[k-2]          *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempSum := (c_b0_notch * rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg) +
            (c_b1_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1) +
            (c_b2_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_X2) -
            (c_a1_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1) -
            (c_a2_notch * rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y2);

rSloshFilter_Pitch_X2 := rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_X1 := rGimbalPitch_Unfiltered_deg;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y2 := rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1;
rSloshFilter_Pitch_Y1 := rTempSum;
rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := rTempSum;

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.2 Yaw Gimbal Discrete Biquad Notch Filter                                                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rTempSum := (c_b0_notch * rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg) +
            (c_b1_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1) +
            (c_b2_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_X2) -
            (c_a1_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1) -
            (c_a2_notch * rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y2);

rSloshFilter_Yaw_X2 := rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_X1 := rGimbalYaw_Unfiltered_deg;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y2 := rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1;
rSloshFilter_Yaw_Y1 := rTempSum;
rGimbalYawCmd_deg   := rTempSum;

(* Mechanical Slew Rate Clamping: 20.0 deg/s *)
IF (rGimbalPitchCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg) > (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg + (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF (rGimbalPitchCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg) < (-c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg - (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevGimbalPitchCmd_deg := rGimbalPitchCmd_deg;

IF (rGimbalYawCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg) > (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg + (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
ELSIF (rGimbalYawCmd_deg - rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg) < (-c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s) THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg - (c_rMaxGimbalSlewRate_degps * c_rCycleDeltaT_s);
END_IF;
rPrevGimbalYawCmd_deg := rGimbalYawCmd_deg;

(* Gimbal Angle Bounds Check: +/- 8.00 deg *)
IF rGimbalPitchCmd_deg > c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
ELSIF rGimbalPitchCmd_deg < -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalPitchCmd_deg := -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
END_IF;

IF rGimbalYawCmd_deg > c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
ELSIF rGimbalYawCmd_deg < -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg THEN
    rGimbalYawCmd_deg := -c_rMaxGimbalAngle_deg;
END_IF;

(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* SECTION 8: MULTI-STAGE AUTONOMOUS DESCENT FLIGHT STATE MACHINE                               *)
(* ============================================================================================= *)
(* Master Abort Override Logic *)
IF bEmergencyAbortCmd OR (wFaultWord_Critical <> 16#0000) THEN
    IF (iStateStep <> 70) AND (iStateStep <> 80) AND (iStateStep <> 99) THEN
        iStateStep := 90; (* Transition immediately to Emergency Abort Ascent *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

CASE iStateStep OF
    0: (* STATE_STANDBY_PRE_DESCENT: Orbit verification and sub-Kelvin TVS priming *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;
        bHazardAvoidanceActive:= FALSE;
        bTouchdownConfirmed   := FALSE;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 0.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0001;

        IF bMissionEnable AND (wFaultWord_Critical = 16#0000) THEN
            iStateStep := 10;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_CHILLDOWN_AND_TVS_CONDITIONING: Line conditioning, subcooling verification *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0003;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 5.0;

        (* Verify propellant subcooling margins > 0.80 K and tank pressures conditioned *)
        IF (rLOX_SubcoolingMargin_K >= 0.80) AND (rLCH4_SubcoolingMargin_K >= 0.80) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 3.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 20;
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ULLAGE_AND_IGNITION: Torch igniter excitation and pintle pre-positioning *)
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := TRUE;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := 3.20; (* Initial ignition pintle crack *)
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#0007;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 10.0;

        IF rStateTimer_Sec >= 0.350 THEN
            bEngineMainValvesCmd := TRUE; (* Open main propellant cryogenic valves *)
        END_IF;

        (* Confirm chamber pressure rise Pc >= 12.0 bar to verify flame establishment *)
        IF (rChamberPress_Pc_bar >= 12.0) AND (rStateTimer_Sec >= 0.850) THEN
            iStateStep := 30; (* Main engine lit, enter powered braking phase *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_POWERED_BRAKING_BURN: High thrust decel from orbital velocity (100% to 70%) *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE; (* De-energize torch spark once combustion steady *)
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#000F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 20.0 + ((2500.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 2500.0 * 40.0);

        (* Trajectory state-space reference targets for high-altitude braking *)
        aX_Target[1] := 450.0; (* Approach gate altitude *)
        aX_Target[2] := -15.0; (* Vertical velocity gate [m/s] *)

        (* Transition gate: Altitude <= 450 m and vertical speed reduced below -18 m/s *)
        IF (rVoted_Alt_m <= 450.0) AND (rVoted_VelZ_mps >= -18.0) THEN
            iStateStep := 40; (* Enter pitch-over approach *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_PITCH_OVER_APPROACH: Throttle to 50%-35%, orient lander vertical for sensors *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#001F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 60.0 + ((450.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 450.0 * 20.0);

        aX_Target[2] := -4.0;  (* Approach vertical speed *)

        aX_Target[1] := 45.0;
        aX_Target[2] := -2.0;

        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#007F;
        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 90.0 + ((35.0 - rVoted_Alt_m) / 35.0 * 9.0);

        aX_Target[1] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[2] := -1.00; (* 1.0 m/s gentle touchdown *)
        aX_Target[3] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[4] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[5] := 0.0;
        aX_Target[6] := 0.0;

        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;

        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;

        rDescentPhaseProgress_Pct := 100.0;
        wFlightStateWord      := 16#00FF; (* Touchdown achieved *)

            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;

    80: (* STATE_POST_LANDING_PASSIVATION: Blowdown cryo lines, depressurize tanks *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;

        rVentValve_LOX_Cmd_Pct  := 100.0;
        rVentValve_LCH4_Cmd_Pct := 100.0;
        bTVS_MixerPump_LOX_Cmd  := FALSE;
        bTVS_MixerPump_LCH4_Cmd := FALSE;

        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := TRUE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := TRUE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := c_rMaxThrust_kN; (* 65.0 kN 100% full throttle *)
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMaxPintleStroke_mm; (* 18.50 mm full stroke *)
        (* Gimbal upright to pitch back into orbital insertion vector *)
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := -3.50;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;

        rAbortAscentTimer_Sec := rAbortAscentTimer_Sec + c_rCycleDeltaT_s;

            iStateStep := 99; (* Abort burn complete, safe cutoff in orbit *)
            rStateTimer_Sec := 0.0;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_CRITICAL_FAILSAFE_LOCKOUT: Complete subsystem isolation *)
        bEngineMainValvesCmd  := FALSE;
        bEngineMainIgniterCmd := FALSE;
        rThrustCmd_kN         := 0.0;
        rPintleStrokeCmd_mm   := c_rMinPintleStroke_mm;
        rGimbalPitchCmd_deg   := 0.0;
        rGimbalYawCmd_deg     := 0.0;
